_about: Names for The Dam Busters's routines and globals, with the evidence for each.

Routine keys are image offsets, the coordinate comrec's labels use. Global keys are the addresses the program sees. In a single-segment MZ they are the same, but keeping the two sections separate keeps the intent explicit. Getting them the wrong way round is the mistake that costs a session, and the only symptom is silence.

This is the start of the reading, not the end. What is named here is the entry point, the main loop, the timer/music/keyboard/video subsystems, and the top-level game phases. Every name carries the evidence that established it; something without evidence stays unnamed rather than becoming a plausible guess.
The three toolkit fixes that took the decode rate from 12.3% to 26.7% are recorded in BRIEF.md, not here -- they are facts about comrec, not facts about this game.

0x00000: the MZ entry (CS:IP -> 0000:0000 from mzinfo); sets DS := CS in the first two instructions, which is what a single-segment .COM-in-MZ program does
0x0002D: an infinite `jmp $` reached from the detection loop's dead exit at 0x2C. In the shipped file the loop always falls through to post_boot, but the failure branch is preserved
0x0002F: reached from the head of the file after a 16-round hardware detection loop falls through. Saves SP into [saved_sp] so restart_run can restore it, then calls init_cga_mode, set_default_palette, save_kbd_isr, spins a 65,536-iteration delay, then install_timer_isr, install_kbd_isr, and two subsystem init routines before falling through into the main-loop setup
0x00053: the target of `jmp L_00053` in main_loop when both end_of_run_flag and restart_ready_flag are set. Restores SP from saved_sp, clears end_of_run_flag, zeroes SI, then falls through to main_setup
0x0005F: called on every run start (from post_boot and from restart_run). set_loop_song(0), a pinned call to 0x6EB8, install_kbd_isr, install_timer_isr -- then falls through into main_loop
0x0006B: the per-frame loop. Atomically moves tick_flags -> tick_flags_working under CLI/STI, waits for bit 0 (the frame tick), calls per_frame_step then check_phase_transition, then dispatches to the current phase handler via `call word [bx*2 + phase_dispatch]`. If end_of_run_flag becomes non-zero the code spins waiting for restart_ready_flag and jumps to restart_run; otherwise it polls ack_pending_flag and, when set, waits for the '1' key before reinstalling the keyboard ISR
0x000CB: a single `ret`. Table entry for the phase-dispatch slot that does nothing
0x001A4: phase_init_dispatch[4]. Draws the header (draw_map_border) with 'GREAT BRITAIN' etc., resets the target-region field to 0xFFFF, then falls through into map_screen_step for the first frame
0x001B0: phase_dispatch[4]. Per-frame update of the map-selection screen: reads and applies cursor input via update_map_view, clamps the position with clamp_map_position (which wraps between adjacent regions), redraws on movement, and calls the map's sub-updates
0x001DA: if the cursor-input flag [0xD1C3] is set, toggles [0x10E] between the two cached positions ([0xF4..0xF8] and [0xFA..0xFE]) and calls draw_map_border. The [0x10F] guard rejects re-entrancy from held keys
0x00226: if the save-position flag [0xD1C5] is set, copies the working position [0xF4..0xF8] into the cached slot [0xFA..0xFE]. Called from map_screen_step after movement is applied
0x00240: clamps the (x, y, region) triple at DS:SI: x is folded into 0..0xDF (0..223) and y into 0..0x8F (0..143); when x wraps around, the region index at offset +4 steps to the adjacent map (with 0<->3 and 2<->5 acting as edges that clamp rather than wrap). Returns carry set when a wrap occurred
0x002BF: sets the text drawer's parameter block (draw at [0xD9A2..0xD9BE]) to the header slot and text address 0xEBD8, calls draw_text, then falls through into draw_map_border to redraw the whole frame
0x002E0: draws the map screen's 4-piece border using sprite drawer L_0D631 with parameter block [0xD627..0xD62F]: sprite 0xE632 across the top and bottom edges at y=0x20/0xB8, then alternating figures 0x114/0x115/0x116/0x117 down the left and right edges; also draws the four corners with L_0DA39 at (0x16,0x25), (0x88,0x25), (0x16,0xB8), (0x88,0xB8), and the region title read from a table at 0xED26 indexed by [0xF8]
0x008AB: compares game_phase to requested_phase; if they differ and the current phase is not 8 (end), it sets the new phase, clears CGA to 0, resets the palette, and calls the phase-init handler from phase_init_dispatch (the cs:0x8d2 table)
0x00D62: the first of the two calls out of main_loop. Times out a border-flash counter at [0x6AD6], runs six model-update routines and six render/audio routines when bit 5 of tick_flags_working is set, then drains music_bar_count via a loop that calls four sub-steps. Deep enough to be worth splitting later
0x00E46: per_frame_step[1]. Reads [0x3070] (roll input), scales by 4, integrates into [0xBC4] (accumulated heading rate); saturates to [-6,+6] when [0x3072]==0 (auto-stabilise). Copies to [0xBC6] (heading rate), then integrates it into [0xBC8]/[0xBCA] as a signed word; wraps [0xBC9] mod 0x168 (360). [0xBC9] is the plane heading in degrees
0x00E8D: per_frame_step[1]. Averages the four engine-load bytes at [0x1735..0x173B] (skipping zeros), maps through table at 0xCDB, subtracts [0x23A5] (target altitude), scales by throttle and integrates into [0xCE6] (current altitude). Ends the run with reason 7 if [0xCE6] > 0x186 (over the ceiling); clamps to 0 when it dips below. Also picks a music-loop pointer based on engine average (call set_loop_song)
0x00F4F: per_frame_step[1]. Averages the engine outputs from left pair ([0x1735], [0x1737]) minus right pair ([0x173B], [0x1739]), divides by 16, adds [0x23A9] and [0x7D35] offsets, stores in [0xBC4]. Engine imbalance drives the heading rate that integrate_heading reads next
0x00F80: per_frame_step[1]. Combines throttle [0x306D] and roll magnitude [0x3070] into a speed, scales by altitude [0xCE6]/2, calls L_01373 (a trig helper), and accumulates into distance [0xBCB]. Sets damage flag [0xBCF] when it saturates non-zero
0x00FBF: per_frame_step[1]. Multiple crash checks against combined roll/distance thresholds: reason 4 = stalled below target ([0x23A3]==2 and [0xBD2] < 12), reason 3 = damage-flag-with-fuel-out condition, reason 2 = throttle-and-distance conflict. Each triggers `jmp end_run`
0x01031: per_frame_step[1]. Reads throttle [0x306D], transforms via L_01394, multiplies by altitude [0xCE6], then dispatches through cs:0x1045 by [0x104] (map_region). Each of the six region cases modifies the accumulated distance/altitude by a region-specific rule
0x01051: cs:0x1045[0] and cs:0x1045[3]: multiplies the incoming value by 2 (shl) then calls region_effect_default. Reached from apply_region_flight_effect for map_region = 0 or 3
0x01058: cs:0x1045[1]: branches on [0xBE3]; if non-zero, shifts and double-invokes region_effect_default; otherwise the plain path
0x01062: cs:0x1045[5]: shifts right depending on [0x5512]; halves the distance contribution
0x0106D: cs:0x1045[2] and cs:0x1045[4]: adds AX to [0xBD0] (distance-fine), and on wrap increments [0xBD2] (whole distance), then advances the plane position via step_plane_position
0x01074: per_frame_step[1] inner step. Increments the whole-distance counter [0xBD2], reads heading [0xBC9], scales the fractional sin/cos into [0xBD4]/[0xBD6], and integrates the high bytes into world position [0x100]/[0x102]. Then calls update_map_position
0x010BC: clamps the world position [0x100]/[0x102] via clamp_map_position, and if the tile coordinate ([0x100]>>3 or [0x102]>>3) changed, calls update_visible_tiles. Detects tile crossings that require a redraw
0x010F7: writes 10 map tile bytes into [0xBDA..0xBE3] by walking a per-heading pattern (from table at 0xBFB/0xC4B) around the current tile position [0xBD8]/[0xBD9]. These are the tiles the drawing code reads to build the terrain view
0x010FA: the body of update_visible_tiles reached without recomputing the direction (BX already holds the direction index)
0x0112E: reads [0xBC9] heading, shifts right 4 (16-directional slice), indexes into table at 0xBE4 for the direction code returned in BX
0x01141: reads a byte from the world tile map at (dl=col, dh=row, di=region), with wrap: column wraps every 0x1C into di+/-1 (region step), row wraps every 0x12 across three-region rows. Rows are indexed via table at 0xC9B, columns via cs:0xED26 (from -0x12DA)
0x011C4: per_frame_step[1]. Calls yaw_to_direction; if the 16-directional heading tile at [0xBC0] changed, jumps to update_visible_tiles to redraw
0x0136B: another sine variant taking heading in a different unit; used by step_plane_position
0x01373: sine of AX (heading in degrees), returned in AX scaled to 64. Used by integrate_distance and update_camera_transform
0x01394: cosine of AX (heading in degrees), returned in AX scaled to 64. Used by apply_region_flight_effect and update_camera_transform
0x0174B: phase_init_dispatch[5]. A menu screen: restores the cursor position from [0x1749] into [0x1718], calls L_0DF0E to draw text at SI=0x13A6, zeroes 8 per-row counters at 0x16C0..0x1706 (10 bytes apart, one per menu row), sets up the input state via L_01826, and calls L_01A37/L_01A81 for the initial paint
0x017AC: phase_dispatch[5]. Calls menu_input (L_017C8) with the base text at 0x1B57, updates the visible options, then saves the cursor back to [0x1749] so the next entry to this phase restores where the player was
0x017C8: shared menu-input handler used by phases 5 and 6. When [0xD1C5] is set (the fire/select trigger), it dispatches through cs:0x1610 by the current menu index [0x1718]. Otherwise it steps the cursor from held-key state ([0xD1C2] bit 0 up, bit 1 down) with a 0x10-tick repeat delay held in [0x171A]
0x01823: tail-call entry to draw_menu_cursor: stores AL into [0x1718] first, then falls through. Three jump sites in menu_input's directional-key branches all read a next-position byte from tables at 0x1636/0x1649/0x165C/0x166F (per-direction) and jump here
0x01826: reads two coordinate bytes from tables at 0x1682/0x1683 indexed by [0x1718]*2, writes them into the drawing block [0xD9BE]/[0xD9C0], and calls L_0DD37 with SI=0x21CF to draw the cursor sprite
0x01871: draws all four engine gauges by walking [0x173D] engine_states and picking display sprite 2 or 3 based on whether the engine is running. Called from menu_main_init and use_fire_ext_shared
0x01895: menu handler (cs:0x1610[4]): activates the fire extinguisher on engine 1 (bx=0). Tail-jumps into use_fire_ext_shared with bx=0
0x01898: the tail-call target of use_fire_ext_engine_1..4. If input_flags bit 1 is set and [bx + engine_states] bit 0 is clear, sets that bit (marking the extinguisher used on that engine), clears the two damage counters at [(bx*2) + 0x172D] and [(bx*2) + 0x1735], and calls L_01871 (redraw) and L_063BD with AX=6 (probably the whoosh sound effect)
0x018D4: redraws the top row of engine gauges from the four engine_slider_top values. Called after any adjust_engine_slider_top_* handler
0x0191D: menu handler (cs:0x1610[0]): +/- adjust value at [0x1725] (engine 1). Value ranges 0..0x28 = 40. Test byte [0x171c] bit 0 = inc, bit 1 = dec. Redraws via L_01AC8 (border/gauge) and L_018D4 (the pointer-draw pass). One of the two per-engine slider rows on the cockpit page -- BOOSTER GAUGES, RPM GAUGES, THROTTLES are the labels shown from text at 0x13A6; which of them this row is has not been settled from the code
0x01950: menu handler (cs:0x1610[1]): engine 2 (bx=2) counterpart of adjust_engine_slider_top_1
0x0195F: menu handler (cs:0x1610[15]): loops bx=0,2,4,6 calling the shared body -- adjusts all four engines' top-row slider together
0x01970: redraws the bottom row of engine gauges from engine_slider_bottom. Called after any adjust_engine_slider_bottom_* handler
0x019B7: menu handler (cs:0x1610[8]): +/- adjust value at [0x171D] (engine 1). Value ranges 0..0x18 = 24. Same shape as adjust_engine_slider_top_1 but with a different base and redraw (L_01970). Which cockpit label this row corresponds to has not been settled
0x019F9: menu handler (cs:0x1610[16]): loops bx=0,2,4,6 for the bottom row
0x01A0A: walks all four engine states and updates each engine's status light -- non-2 states blink at half-second cadence via bit 5 of tick_counter
0x01A37: draws small numeric selectors on the menu_main page
0x01A81: the bottom-of-screen footer text on menu_main
0x01AC8: called after any menu handler updates a slider value. Redraws all four engine-gauge overlays from [0x1725..0x172B] (engine_slider_top) and [0x171D..0x1723] (engine_slider_bottom)
0x023B9: phase_init_dispatch[6]. Same shape as menu_main_init but with different tables and text (SI=0x21D9, text base 0x25B1, 5 per-row counters at 0x2365..0x2395 spaced by 10). The state [0x1718] is restored from [0x23AB] (a different save slot than menu_main uses, so the two menus keep their own cursor positions)
0x02408: phase_dispatch[6]. Uses the same menu_input handler as menu_main_step but writes the cursor back to [0x23AB]
0x02421: reads the current option index [0x239F] to pick a letter from the table at 0x2347, patches the template at [0x2288 + 5], and calls draw_display_list. Called by cycle_selector_a redraws
0x02433: 3-position selector driven by [0xD1C2] bits 2 (increment) and 3 (decrement) on [0x239F], clamped to 0..2. Uses the tick_flags_working bit 4 as a repeat gate. Redraws via L_02421 (which reads the selected option's letter from a table at 0x2347) and then reads a distance/altitude pair from tables at 0x23AD/0x23B3
0x0244D: tail-call target: redraws the letter (menu_second_draw_option_letter) then syncs the (distance, altitude) pair (menu_second_sync_selection). Reached from cycle_selector_a's increment and decrement paths after [0x239F] moves
0x02450: after cycle_selector_a moves, copies the pair (distance, altitude) from tables at [0x23AD]/[0x23B3] into [0x23A1]/[0x23A5]
0x02483: reads [0x23A3]*2 as a pointer into the row-string table at 0x234A, calls draw_display_list. Called by cycle_selector_b redraws
0x02491: identical to cycle_selector_a but operating on [0x23A3] with different key bits ([0xD1C2] bits 0/1) and a different text lookup. The two selectors together set the two-parameter option shown on the menu_second screen
0x024C3: third of the three initial draw calls in menu_second_init
0x024FA: menu handler (cs:0x1610[14]) on menu_second. Behaviour not yet read
0x02532: draws the two 3-position selectors and their labels on menu_second
0x0309F: phase_init_dispatch[0]. Draws text at SI=0x2E8E, zeroes flight state ([0x304E], [0x3044], [0x3058], [0x3062], [0x599B]), sets three unknowns at [0x3099..0x309D] to 0xFFFF (sentinels), then calls L_04F5B and L_0508E. Falls through into flight_forward_step
0x030E1: phase_dispatch[0]. Reads input flags from [0xD1C2] into [0x306B] (used bit-wise as up/down/left/right by physics_step), copies plane position ([0xBC6], [0x3070], [0x306D]) into the camera slots [0x4DA5]/[0x4DA3]/[0x4DA7], sets a drawing region 0x10..0x40 x 0x10..0x80, and calls a chain of update+draw routines
0x0312A: the plane's per-frame physics. Reads control input bitfield [0x306B] (bit 0 = up, bit 1 = down, bit 2 = left, bit 3 = right), integrates pitch/roll into [0x3073] and [0x3075], and drives the altitude computation from [0xCE6] - [0x23A1]. Also triggers the crash branch (`jmp L_07DA3`) when [0x306D] falls below -0x2C
0x03ECB: phase_init_dispatch[1]. Same shape as flight_forward_init but different text (SI=0x3C38), a larger drawing region (0x18..0xB8 y), initialises the target-lock state at [0x3EBD..0x3EC3] to the bomb-run sight rectangle (0x28,0x78,0x20,0xAC), and shows an alternate briefing at 0x3DB4 when [0xBBF] is set (that flag is set 30 frames after [0x4B61] is 1 in per_frame_step)
0x03F4B: phase_dispatch[1]. Same camera setup as flight_forward_step, then either the normal per-frame chain (L_0408C..L_0420B) when [0xBBF]==0, or a transition path when it is set: displays a message, waits for input via [0xD1C5], and eventually jumps to L_084C7 -- reaching flight_bombrun_end and the results phase
0x03FDD: phase_init_dispatch[2]. Same shape as the other flight phase inits but with text SI=0x3CF3, initialises target-lock bounds [0x3EBD..0x3EC3] to (0x28,0x78,0x20,0xA0) using [0x3EB5]/[0x3EB7] rather than [0x3EB1]/[0x3EB3], and a slightly shorter y drawing range (0x18..0xA8)
0x04046: phase_dispatch[2]. Distinctive: negates all three camera coordinates (`neg ax` on [0xBC6], [0x3070], [0x306D]) before writing them into [0x4DA5..0x4DA7]. Reversed sign of the camera turns the same 3D drawing pipeline into a look-behind view -- almost certainly the rear-gunner station
0x0408C: reads input flags into [0x306B] via the bomb-run's own mapping, then updates the target-lock rectangle at [0x3EBD..0x3EC3] toward the current cursor position [0x3EB9]/[0x3EBB]
0x040FF: the head of the bomb-run per-phase state -- called from flight_bombrun_init and flight_rearview_init. Zeroes several counters at [0x3EAF..0x3EBB]
0x0411E: one of the bomb-run per-frame update calls. Reads a state timer at [0x3EAF] and drives a small state machine over target-lock and release-arming
0x04180: second bomb-run update call. Fires the actual bomb-release when the target-lock has been held long enough (checks the counter at [0x3E64])
0x041B5: tail-call target inside bombrun_step_state_b: walks four target-lock slots at [0x3DC1]/[0x3E01] and draws each active one via draw_sprite_at with sprite 0x42A2. Reached via jmp when the state update path finishes physics but must still render the locks
0x0420B: third bomb-run update call. Handles the animation from bomb-release through impact, and drives the phase-7 transition when the outcome is decided
0x04B63: phase_init_dispatch[3]. A smaller drawing region than the flight phases (0x28..0x98 y), sprite base [0xD627]=0xF902, text SI=0x4A3A and 0x42A4, then a chain that includes draw_bomb_options -- two YES/NO toggle boxes drawn from strings at 0x46D6 (off) and 0x4700 (on)
0x04BA2: phase_dispatch[3]. Reads plane position into camera slots (with [0x4DA3] zeroed rather than following [0x3070]), calls the option-page input dispatch (L_017C8, the shared menu handler that dispatches through cs:0x1610), and either draws the two toggle indicators via draw_bomb_options or a fallback text screen at 0x4B1F
0x04BCF: input handler reached through cs:0x1610: bit 0 of [0xD1C2] sets [0x4B61] := 0, bit 1 sets it to 1; then redraws via draw_bomb_options
0x04BEB: same shape as toggle_bomb_option_1 but writes [0x4B62]; the second of the two YES/NO options on the bomb_options screen
0x04C07: draws two YES/NO toggle boxes (positions y=0x29 and y=0x71) picked between text at 0x46D6 (off) and 0x4700 (on) by the flags [0x4B61] and [0x4B62]. Called from bomb_options_init and from the toggle handlers L_04BCF and L_04BEB when the player flips a choice
0x04EDA: recomputes the 2x2 camera matrix at [0x4D9F]/[0x4DA1] and the translation ([0x4DAE]/[0x4DB0]) from the current roll [0x4DA3] and pitch [0x4DA7]. Uses L_01373 (sin) and L_01394 (cos) as the trig helpers, and a small lookup at 0x4EC2 for the pitch-to-screen mapping. Called once per frame from each flight phase's step
0x04F5B: populates the 16-slot scenery table at [0x4D14] with random-but-distinct X positions (a rejection loop that re-rolls if the value collides with an existing one). Called from three phase inits, always with the object pool freshly cleared
0x04F92: with 1-in-32 probability (via prng_step), replaces one of the 16 scenery slots [0x4D14] with a new (row, col) picked from prng_step. Called once per frame -- keeps the scenery drifting
0x0504D: 2x2 matrix-multiply of (AX, BX) by the camera matrix at [0x4D9F..0x4DA1] (sin/cos of roll), scaled by 64 (arith shift right 6), plus translation ([0x4DAE], [0x4DB0]). Returns the screen-space point in (AX, BX). The projection primitive every 3D drawer builds on
0x0508E: walks the 20-slot object pool at 0x51DD, resetting [+4] and [+8] fields on each. Called from every flight phase init
0x050A3: walks the 20-slot object pool at 0x51DD; for each live entry (type != 0), projects its world coord via project_point_2d, culls if beyond 0xC8 or above the screen threshold, and dispatches through cs:0x4E82 by the object type ([+0xA], 0..9). This is the object-render dispatcher for forward view
0x050A6: the top of render_object_pool's per-slot loop
0x050FE: the same shape as render_object_pool but with the world coord mirrored (`neg / add 0x1A4`); called for the rear view (flight_rearview_step) so the same object type dispatches produce the look-behind projection
0x051AD: top-level per-frame render: draws the 16 scenery slots at [0x4D14] then calls render_object_pool. Called from map_screen_step, menu_main_step, menu_second_step, and every flight step
0x051C5: frees an object pool slot by writing 0 to its type at [si + 0xA]. Called by render_object_pool when a slot has aged out
0x05517: per_frame_step[2]. Ages the flak counter at [0x5513] (decrement, then bleed [0x5515] by 4 per 100 ticks). Walks the 20-slot object pool at 0x51DD..0x536D (14 bytes per slot) for a free entry (type at [+0xA] == 0), then rolls the prng to decide what to spawn -- either a light flare (type 7) or a random-type object -- based on damage flags [0xBDA]/[0xBDB]/[0xBDD] and [0xBE3]
0x0564D: per_frame_step[3]. Advances every live entry in the object pool at 0x51DD by the plane's current motion ([0xBC6] * 2). Slots move toward the plane; when they cross a threshold, life ticks down at [+0xA] and eventually the slot frees itself
0x05ABC: per_frame_step[2]. If no enemy currently active ([0x5987] == 0), rolls a probability based on region [0x104], distance [0xBCB] > 0x1000, prior lift flag [0x5984], any tile-of-value-0xB in the visible set, [0x5515] engine load, and whether current region matches [0x9E6] (target region). On success: sets a new enemy at random screen coords ([0x598A]/[0x598D]), sets [0x5987]=1 and [0x5985]=0xA (attack timer), and starts a sound (call L_0638A AX=2 or 3 for direction)
0x05B78: per_frame_step[3]. State machine on [0x5987]: while == 1 it decrements [0x5985] and either completes or resets, then transitions through terminal states 0xFD and 0x11E which stop the sound
0x05BF4: advances the bomb-drop animation over a series of frames. Called from flight_forward_step, flight_bombrun_step, flight_rearview_step
0x0638A: call this with AX = an effect index to trigger a short PIT-channel-2 sound. Called 5 times (spawn_enemy_plane passes 2 or 3 for engine directions; other callers pass 1 for a click). Uses a per-effect note table that is not yet identified
0x063B3: called from L_06465 during bomb-run icon animation. Wraps play_sound_effect with a state check
0x063BD: the counterpart to play_sound_effect. Called with the same effect ID to release/silence it
0x063E6: the bomb-release action: called when the bomb-run reaches its trigger condition. Sets several state bytes and triggers the drop animation via other calls
0x063F0: per_frame_step[2]. When bit 5 of tick_counter is set, draws either a bomb armed (sprite 0x5882) or bomb selected indicator at HUD position (0x4A, 0xBA), edge-detected by [0x6371]. Also plays sound 7 (play_song 7) briefly when [0x6372] is set and [0x6370] decrements past zero
0x06AD7: per_frame_step[2]. Scans the object pool for type-3 objects landing in a specific screen rectangle around the plane (in-window [0x64..0x12C] and [-0x1E..0x1E]); if any are close and a probability check fails (based on table at 0x6ABF by count), triggers a hit: saves current phase into [0xD1CB], sets game_phase to 8 (idle), clears the screen, sets border white (0x0F). When the type-3 danger clears with the game already in phase 8, sets requested_phase to 0xFFFF and calls check_phase_transition to restore
0x06B59: per_frame_step[2]. Same shape as check_flak_hit but for object type 4. Together the two check for hit close enough by any active projectile and force the hit-freeze state
0x07DA3: the run-ending routine. Silences the music (set_loop_song(0) then play_song(8), the death jingle), reads the reason code from [0x7D33] and picks the matching message pointer from a table at 0x7FE1, draws it, calls restore_kbd_isr, drains and consumes one key, then jmp restart_run. Reached by jmp L_07DA3 from physics_step (altitude below -0x2C), from L_07E01 (all crew dead), from L_07E31 (crew position accumulator at 0x7D87 reached 0x190), and from L_03162
0x07DDA: per_frame_step[2]. Ages counters at [bx + 0x2397] (per-engine damage stage), then walks [0x173D] (engine_states): if any engine is state 2 (dead), accumulates its position counter and can end the run (reason 8 = all crew dead, or reason 6 = crew position accumulator > 0x190)
0x084C7: post-bomb-run outcome handler. Sets [0x84C6] := 1, silences music, clears the framebuffer, then branches on [0xBE3] (0 or 0x12 = normal outcome, else crash) and [0xBCB] (distance from target) into one of several result-screen paths -- hit, near miss, miss.
